title: ci: widen the Test Core matrix to 10 shards so the 2026-11-16 timings fit the 1868s whole-leg cap (blocks #34314)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the shard-partitioner self-test red on PR #34314 (the 2026-11-16 Test Core timings refresh the maintainer ordered merged), read by area `o2-C` at head `5009c644` (run 44035625632, job 133877684767) and reproduced locally. Dedupe: `WHOLE_LEG_CAP_SECONDS`, `Test Core shards`; no open card (#31518 is the merge-queue cascade card, not this).

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:devx · blocks #34314

## 维护者速读

- 现象：按 11-16 刷新的耗时数据，Test Core 8 片里有 5 片的整包合计约 2195s,超过 1868s 上限，分片器自检拒绝,#34314 合不进去。
- 为什么要修：不是数据坏了，也不是装箱器的 bug。79 个共有包的总耗时从 11636s 涨到 16472s,各包中位数涨了 1.36 倍,8 片下任何分法都过不了上限。数据集只决定怎么分，实际跑的时长已经是这个量级，所以现在 main 上的分片在真实 CI 里也已经超载。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。修法照源码现有规则：加宽矩阵。动 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`,PR 会走 Tier H,由 os-zhuang 批。

## Readings (area o2-C, head `5009c644`)

- Self-test: `whole leg, committed dataset at 8 shards (sums 2195/663/2193/2194/1446/1445/2193/2195s)`; shards 1, 3, 4, 7, 8 past the 1868s cap; `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` share shard 8/8.
- Whole packages 14524s + CLI 2245.53s (3 slices) + the declaration-reading slice's closure charge 783s; (14524 + 2245.53 + 783) / 1868 = 9.4, so at least 10 shards with CLI kept at 3 slices. 9 shards average about 1950s and still exceed the cap. Slicing CLI to 8 still leaves about 1913s and is refused by pin 3c. Slicing another package (e.g. `spec`) needs `OS_TEST_SHARD` support in that package and a generator decode change: a larger card.
- Biggest rises: service-analytics x2.85, verify x2.55, driver-sql x2.32, spec x1.75, plugin-auth x1.60. The new window's 3 runs each ran all 82 packages; the old window's 6 runs ran 43 to 79 (less co-run contention, possibly lower readings; a guess, not measured).

## Governing text

`scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`, the `WHOLE_LEG_CAP_SECONDS` docblock: "When a refresh grows the whole legs past the cap, the remedy is a wider matrix or a finer slice, never a denser shard." and "Raising this number needs a merge-queue red-rate reading at the new figure, not a balance figure". So the cap stays and the matrix widens.

## Change

1. Widen the Test Core matrix from 8 to 10 shards: the `test` job's matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (including its `|| '[1, ..., 8]'` fallback) and whatever `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs` `liveShardTotal('test')` and the generator's decode read, so `SHARD_COUNT` follows.
2. Re-plan the committed dataset at 10 shards and keep every self-test pin green, including `LOAD_SENSITIVE_APART`.
3. Then #34314 rebases onto it and lands.

## Done when

`node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test` passes on `main` with the 2026-11-16 dataset of #34314, and #34314 merges.
